notes.title: Happy Birthday!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,

Last week, we celebrated [b]four amazing years since Terrain of Magical Expertise first launched[/b] – can you believe it? We wanted to make this anniversary extra special, so we’ve got a little birthday surprise for you: TOME now has a [b]full set of community items on Steam[/b]! That means you can collect [i]Trading Cards[/i], [i]Profile Backgrounds[/i], [i]Badges[/i], and [i]Emojis[/i], either just by playing the game or in the Steam Point Shop.

Here’s a little sneak peek of what’s waiting for you:
[/p][h3][b]Trading Cards[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40299562/913824cd85911223d13ae22346069349251419ca.png"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]Profile Backgrounds[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40299562/29cd31a95ee7d8ce269e2d7b0539b971f7dbd714.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Badges[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40299562/c8cc9e6e4bdbbe6cb818221693988791c6e20e44.png"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]Emojis[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40299562/9798ee943e741252ac491ab323a5511fe0f7ccef.png"][/img]
[/p][p]You can check out the full set [u][url="https://www.steamcardexchange.net/index.php?gamepage-appid-1543430"]right here[/url][/u].

But that’s not all. Chris Niosi, the creator of Terrain of Magical Expertise series and video game, shared a short video on the anniversary day with even more news:
[/p][previewyoutube="NZNuB11uaaU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
So, not just that you can now [u][url="https://tee-zr.com/store/kirbopher/"]grab a Nylocke “WHOOSH!” T-shirt or hoodie[/url][/u], but there’s also a chance [b]TOME could come to consoles in the future[/b]!

Since the 2017 Kickstarter was such a success – all thanks to your incredible support! – we’re exploring the idea of a new campaign that would let the community help shape the game and enjoy some awesome rewards. Console players might also gain access to exclusive content, including new items, boss battles, levels, cutscenes, and more.

Nothing’s set in stone yet, but if you’d love to see TOME on consoles, please leave a comment under Chris’s video. Your input would be a huge help in our decision!

Thank you so much for supporting TOME over these 4 years, you guys mean the world to us![/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Join The Battle Between Magic And Technology In New Arc Line!
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

We have some especially exciting news for you! Fulqrum Publishing, along with the developers from Dreamate Games, have officially revealed their new project called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/]New Arc Line[/url].

[b]Official Announcement Trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=ssM2CrCIbEE;full][/previewyoutube]

New Arc Line is a new single-player, story-rich RPG set during the gilded age of magic and technology, which will introduce you to a troubled society: 

The New World looms on the horizon and on its shore New Arc, the shining city of progress, the last beacon of hope in your search for a cure to your family's fatal disease. But you will soon discover that the city's beauty runs only skin-deep; tensions growing between different factions in the world of arcane magic and steampunk gadgets, the rich exploiting the poor, the humanoid hunting the monstrous, and in the middle of it all you, a stranger in a strange land, unaware of the role you have to play in shaping the future of this world... Which side will you choose? What will you become?

If that sounds interesting, make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/]wishlist the game[/url] and visit its Steam store page to learn more details about New Arc Line.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458310/New_Arc_Line/

And to find out even more about New Arc Line and stay up to date on its development, feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/MCAYysT7N9]join the official New Arc Line Discord server[/url], we are looking forward to chatting with you there!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40299562/646afcb0ab726aa595e37e1ded99beb752d6783f.jpg[/img]

Greetings hackers!

We are back with another update for Terrain of Magical Expertise! This update fixes the softlocking issues that still affected some players, brings in expanded support for the ASUS Aura  and a plethora of other fixes and improvements.

We would also like to use this opportunity to thank all of our fans, who share their feedback and / or support in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1543430/discussions/0/]Steam Forums[/url]. [*] Set up assurances to prevent softlocks after Smooch's Rhythm Battle and secret boss fight in the "Kiwi Caverns".

[*] More glitches have been fixed for when you start a New Game after finishing the credits sequence on another file.
[*] The "Flowered" status ailment now carries other status ailments back and forth with it.
[*] Abilities are now ensured to be completed when a character is KO'd, preventing other softlocks from happening after an enemy is defeated.

[*] Removed a blank control map from WiiU pro controller that may have been causing issues

[/list]

[u][h3]Kapital: Sparks of Revolution[/h3][/u]
Kapital: Sparks of Revolution is a hybrid of city-builder and society management game. You play as a new mayor of the city that was recently destroyed by war. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1399700/Kapital_Sparks_of_Revolution/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1334730/Dread_Templar/
[u][h3]Terrain of Magical Expertise[/h3][/u]
TOME – Terrain of Magical Expertise – is a game about a game! Take on the role of a White-Hat Hacker, battling your way through a turn-based RPG adventure with hundreds of unique enemies, doing anything it takes to achieve victory in the Campaign of Champions!

notes.title: Terrains Of Magical Expertise joins forces with 1C Entertainment!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40299562/fcc86881223ab27564bcfbed270718753b317cd9.jpg[/img]
